job.title: Maintenance Officer
job.description:
Company

Join a well-established organisation operating within the residential aged care sector. They are looking for an experienced Maintenance Officer to take ownership of maintenance across a 100-bed facility in Warrawee.

This is a permanent, site-based position offering plenty of autonomy and variety, ideal for someone who enjoys being the go-to person for all things maintenance.

Benefits

  • Up to $75k + super
  • Permanent, full-time position
  • Monday–Friday, 38-hour week
  • Flexible hours – 7am–3pm or 8am–4pm
  • One consistent site in Warrawee
  • Autonomous position with ownership of site maintenance
  • Varied, hands-on role
  • ASAP start available

The Role

As the sole Maintenance Officer on site, you’ll take responsibility for the general upkeep of the facility, grounds, plant and equipment.

No two days will be exactly the same. You’ll complete general repairs and maintenance including painting, plastering, equipment repairs, minor plumbing and electrical work and gardening, while bringing in specialist contractors when required.

You’ll also manage preventative and corrective maintenance schedules, maintain accurate records and coordinate external trades and maintenance suppliers attending the facility.

Requirements

  • Hands-on general maintenance experience
  • A practical, all-round maintenance skill set
  • Trade qualification highly regarded – any trade considered
  • Comfortable working autonomously and managing your own workload
  • Experience organising and coordinating external trades
  • Strong communication and customer service skills
  • Good understanding of workplace health and safety
  • Previous aged care or healthcare maintenance experience advantageous, but not essential
  • Electrical licence is not required

Apply

If you’re an experienced Maintenance Officer, Handyman or tradesperson looking for a stable permanent role where you can take ownership of your own site, I’d love to hear from you.

job.title: HSEQ Representative
job.description:
HSEQ Representative

Ingleburn, Sydney NSW
Full-time permanent |
$100,000 to $118,000 + Super

Permanent opportunity with an established engineering and manufacturing business.
Varied role across health, safety, environment and quality.
38-hour working week, potential overtime and immediate start available.

About the company
MAYDAY Recruitment is partnering with an established engineering and manufacturing business to recruit an HSEQ Representative based in Ingleburn.
Supporting factory operations and project sites, you will work closely with internal teams, suppliers and contractors to maintain compliance, strengthen HSEQ processes and drive continuous improvement.

About the role
You will support the implementation and maintenance of Health, Safety, Environment and Quality systems, ensuring compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and applicable statutory and contractual requirements.
This position combines hands-on engagement with manufacturing and project teams, audit coordination, quality assurance and document control.

Key responsibilities
  • Maintain HSEQ procedures, registers, records and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate and support internal and external audits, tracking findings through to closeout.
  • Monitor compliance with QA/QC and WHS procedures across factory and site operations.
  • Prepare and maintain quality documentation, including Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and Manufacturer Data Records (MDRs).
  • Investigate and document incidents, accidents and non-conformances, supporting corrective and preventive actions.
  • Liaise with suppliers, contractors and project teams to verify HSEQ compliance.
  • Control and issue engineering drawings and documentation.
  • Maintain KPI records and prepare compliance reports.
  • Support inductions, toolbox talks, training and HSEQ awareness activities.
  • Contribute to improvements in safety, quality, efficiency and compliance.
  • Visit other sites, suppliers and subcontractor facilities as required.

Requirements
  • At least three years’ experience in HSEQ, quality assurance, quality control or document control within manufacturing, engineering, fabrication, construction or heavy industry.
  • Strong understanding of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 17025.
  • Experience conducting internal audits and supporting external certification audits.
  • Sound knowledge of quality systems, inspections, testing, document control and compliance processes.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and confidence working with a range of stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and document management systems.

Desirable experience
  • Internal Auditor qualification.
  • Background in engineering, fabrication, mining or heavy industrial environments.
  • Knowledge of relevant Australian Standards and customer quality requirements.
  • Experience managing customer documentation submissions and manufacturing record books.

job.title: Commercial Maintenance Plumber
job.description:
Company: An established plumbing and maintenance contractor is looking for a qualified Commercial Maintenance Plumber to join their growing service team.
This is a permanent field-based position working across a variety of commercial sites throughout Sydney, with a strong focus on service, maintenance and fault finding rather than construction.

Benefits
  • Permanent full-time role
  • Fully maintained company vehicle
  • Heaps of overtime available with strong earning potential
  • Varied field service role across Sydney
  • Work autonomously across a variety of customer sites
  • Join an established business with major contracts

Shift Structure & Pay
  • Monday to Friday, 7:00am–3:30pm
  • $42–$48 per hour + super
  • STRAIGHT DOUBLE OVERTIME
  • With 10 hours weekly OT: Earn $120,000-$140,000 +super

The Role
This is a field-based role carrying out commercial plumbing maintenance across customer sites throughout Sydney. You will be responsible for attending scheduled and reactive jobs, diagnosing issues and completing repairs and maintenance to a high standard.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Reactive and preventative maintenance
  • Fault finding and diagnosing issues
  • Attending leaks, blockages and other plumbing faults
  • Drainage maintenance and repairs
  • Maintaining and repairing hot and cold-water systems
  • Replacing and repairing plumbing fixtures and components
  • Liaising with customers and site contacts
  • Completing service reports and job documentation
  • Working autonomously across multiple customer sites

Requirements:
  • Certificate III in Plumbing essential
  • Strong fault-finding and problem-solving ability
  • Confident working autonomously in a field service environment
  • Good communication and customer service skills
  • Full driver's licence & can drive manual
  • A police check will be undertaken if successful

If you’re interested apply now.

job.title: Electrical Service Technician
job.description:
Join an established global automation and engineering business specialising in intralogistics and automated systems, delivering solutions across airports, logistics and commercial infrastructure. The business is experiencing significant growth in Australia, with its local headcount tripling this year. With long-term service contracts supporting multiple logistics and robotics clients, this is an excellent opportunity to join a growing business working on some of Australia's most advanced automated systems.

Benefits
• Permanent full-time role
• 4 on / 4 off roster – giving you half the year off
• Variety across both installation and servicing – get involved in new system installs as well as ongoing maintenance and fault finding
• Rare opportunity to join a global automation company experiencing huge growth in Australia – Australian headcount has tripled this year
• Genuine career progression with the opportunity to move into a Team Leader position as the Australian operation continues to grow


Shift Structure & Pay
• $77.76 per hour flat rate + super
• Approx. $170,000 + super per year
• 4 days on / 4 days off / 4 nights on / 4 days off
• 12-hour shifts – 6am–6pm / 6pm–6am
• Paid at the same flat hourly rate which incorporates overtime, shift loadings, weekend and public holiday penalties


The Role
You’ll be responsible for maintaining, fault finding and installing sophisticated automated material handling and robotic systems.
Your responsibilities will include:
• Electrical fault finding across automated and PLC-controlled systems (Siemens)
• Working with sensors including photoelectric, proximity and encoders
• Fault finding on motors, VSDs and electrical drive systems
• Diagnosing faults via PLC interfaces and control systems
• Working on control panels, relays and safety circuits
• Maintaining conveyor and sortation system controls
• Breakdown response, preventative maintenance and electrical upgrades
• Supporting the installation and commissioning of new automated systems and equipment

About You
To be successful in this role, you'll have:
• Trade qualified Electrician (Certificate III Electrotechnology)
• Experience within industrial automation or automated manufacturing environments
• PLC fault-finding experience

job.title: Electrical Pump Technician
job.description:
Company

A growing specialist in the installation, servicing and maintenance of commercial and industrial pump systems across NSW. Working across commercial buildings, shopping centres, supermarkets, petrol stations and industrial sites, they provide installation, breakdown and preventative maintenance services across pumps, motors, controls and associated equipment.

Due to continued growth, they are looking for an Industrial Electrician with previous experience working on pumps to join their small, experienced service team.

Benefits

  • $55 per hour + super

  • STRAIGHT DOUBLE OVERTIME

  • Company vehicle, phone and uniform

  • Structured workshop and on-the-job pump training

  • Varied field service role across commercial and industrial sites

  • Small, growing team with long-term career opportunities

  • Opportunity to develop deeper mechanical pump knowledge

  • Strong earning potential with heaps of overtime available

Shift Structure & Pay

  • Monday to Friday, 7:00am–3:30pm

  • $55 per hour + super

  • Straight double time for overtime

  • Heaps of overtime available

  • Annual earnings circa $120k–$165k + super

The Role

This is a field service position working across commercial and industrial customer sites throughout Sydney and NSW. You will use your existing industrial electrical and pump experience while receiving further training across the mechanical side of pump servicing and repairs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Electrical fault finding across commercial and industrial pump systems

  • Servicing, maintaining and repairing pumps and associated equipment

  • Fault finding on electric motors, VSDs/VFDs and pump control systems

  • Working across control panels, switches and associated electrical components

  • Diagnosing electrical and mechanical pump faults

  • Breakdown and preventative maintenance

  • Installing and replacing pumps, motors and associated equipment

  • Workshop-based repairs, servicing and training

  • Working autonomously across a variety of customer sites

Requirements

  • Trade qualified Electrician with a current NSW Electrical Licence

  • Industrial electrical maintenance or field service experience

  • Previous hands-on experience working with pumps essential

  • Experience fault finding motors, VSDs/VFDs and electrical control systems

  • Strong electrical fault-finding capability

  • Mechanically minded and interested in developing further pump repair and servicing skills

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a field service environment

  • Full driver's licence

  • Able to pass a police check

Apply Now

If you're an Industrial Electrician with pump experience looking to move into a specialist field service role with excellent overtime, a company vehicle and further technical training, apply now or contact Maisy at maisy@maydaytechnical.com for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Day Shift - Mechanical Fitter
job.description:
The Company
This established heavy industrial company plays a key role in supplying essential materials into the construction, manufacturing and infrastructure sectors across NSW. Operating out of a large-scale processing facility in Blacktown, they offer stable long-term employment within a busy operation where maintenance reliability is critical to keeping production moving.
The site has a strong workshop culture with a large team of Fitters and Boilermakers onsite, supporting both workshop maintenance and production operations across the facility. It's a fast-paced environment with plenty happening day to day, a busy maintenance schedule, and a genuinely good atmosphere across the team.

Benefits
  • Permanent full-time role
  • 6-day work week: Monday – Saturday
  • Day Shift: Mon – Fri 5am–3:30pm | Sat 5am–11am
  • Strong safety culture and well-resourced maintenance team
  • Busy, team-oriented workshop and production environment
  • Blacktown location

Pay Rates & Shift Structure
Base Rate: $50.50 - $52.42 p/h + super
Annualised equivalent: $165,236 - $171,518 + super 
Based on a 56-hour paid week, the standard working pattern is structured as:
  • First 38 hours paid at base rate
  • Next 18 hours paid at time and a half
  • Occasional longer Saturdays or Sunday shutdowns may push additional hours into double time; however, this is not included in the annualised calculations below
Annualised earnings are based on 48 weeks working the standard pattern plus 4 weeks annual leave paid at ordinary hours.

The Role
Working within the maintenance team, you'll be responsible for keeping heavy equipment and processing assets running reliably across a busy industrial site. The role offers exposure across both heavy fixed plant and mobile plant equipment within a workshop and production environment.
Day to day you will be involved in:
  • Maintenance and repairs on heavy fixed plant and mobile plant equipment
  • Fault finding, servicing and preventative maintenance on heavy machinery
  • Supporting shutdowns, breakdown response and reliability work
  • Working closely with operations teams to minimise downtime
  • Workshop-based repairs, fabrication support and onsite maintenance activities
    ​​​​​
Requirements
  • Trade qualification in Mechanical Fitting or similar
  • Experience within heavy industry, recycling, manufacturing or fixed plant environments
  • MIG or stick welding exposure highly regarded
  • High Risk tickets such as confined space, WAH, EWP, Forklift highly desirable

job.title: Industrial Electrician
job.description:
Join an established automation and engineering business specialising in intralogistics and automated systems, delivering solutions across airports, logistics and commercial infrastructure. With long-term service contracts supporting multiple logistics and robotics clients, this is an excellent opportunity to join a growing business working on some of Australia's most advanced automated systems.
Benefits
  • Permanent full-time role
  • Long-term service contracts providing excellent job security
  • Ongoing technical training and career development
  • Exposure to highly automated systems and new technology
  • Mix of stable site-based work and project-based variety
  • Opportunity to work across both installation and ongoing service and maintenance

  • Guaranteed overtime
  • Currently supporting a major installation project scheduled for completion before Christmas

  • Occasional night shifts may be required depending on the end client's operational requirements

  • Strong electrical fault-finding skills

job.description:

Fully Maintained Vehicle + Heaps Overtime!
Earn between $155,000 - $188,000 + super

Our client is one of Australia's leading crane manufacturers and service providers, with a national footprint supporting customers across manufacturing, mining, ports, recycling, logistics and heavy industry. Due to continued growth and a strong pipeline of service and maintenance work, they are looking to add an additional Electrical Crane Technician to their Newcastle team.

Benefits
• Permanent full-time position
• $54–$58 per hour base rate, depending on experience
• Company vehicle provided
• Standard hours: Monday – Friday, 7:00am – 3:00pm
• Consistent OT: average 50–55 hours per week
• Rotating on-call roster (1 week at a time)

This is a field service position working across a variety of industrial sites throughout Newcastle and the Hunter region, with all work allocated by the office the afternoon prior.

Around 90% of your work will be local to the Newcastle/Hunter region, with occasional regional travel across Northern and Central NSW. The wider service territory extends south towards the Hawkesbury, west through regional NSW, north towards Narrabri and along the coast as far as Grafton.

You will be responsible for servicing, fault finding, breakdown repairs and preventative maintenance on overhead cranes, gantries, hoists and associated lifting equipment.

Duties include:
• Electrical fault finding and diagnostics
• Breakdown response and emergency repairs
• Preventative maintenance and inspections
• Testing and commissioning of crane systems
• Working with motors, contactors, VSDs, limit switches and control systems
• Completing service reports and maintenance documentation

Requirements

Structural Engineer – Overhead Crane Design
Ingleburn | Permanent full-time | $135,000 - $160,000

Our client is a well-established Australian engineering and manufacturing business operating within the materials-handling sector is seeking an experienced Structural Engineer for its Ingleburn team.

With a national footprint supporting major industrial, mining, manufacturing and infrastructure clients, the business designs, manufactures and delivers complex overhead-crane, lifting and materials-handling systems.

  • Complete the structural design and analysis of overhead-crane systems.
  • Design bridge girders, runway beams and associated supporting structures.
  • Calculate crane wheel loads, dynamic forces and relevant load combinations.
  • Assess fatigue, buckling, deflection and local stresses within crane structures.
  • Develop practical designs for fatigue-sensitive welded and fabricated steel components.
  • Prepare engineering calculations, design reports and verification documentation.
  • Use structural-analysis and FEA software to model and validate designs.
  • Review drawings and provide technical guidance to drafting and manufacturing teams.
  • Resolve engineering queries arising during fabrication, installation and commissioning.
  • Independently manage design deliverables across multiple projects.
  • Ensure designs comply with relevant crane, structural and manufacturing standards.
Requirements –
  • A degree in Structural, Civil or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • At least five years of direct, hands-on overhead-crane design experience.
  • Experience personally designing crane structures—not solely inspecting, maintaining or commissioning cranes.
  • Strong experience with bridge girders, crane runways and supporting structures.
  • An understanding of both the crane structure and its interaction with the runway system.
  • Experience calculating dynamic crane loads and fatigue-sensitive structural details.
  • Knowledge of AS 1418 or another internationally recognised crane-design code.
  • Experience with structural-analysis, FEA, calculation and CAD packages such as SpaceGASS, Strand7, Mathcad and AutoCAD, or comparable software.
  • Practical knowledge of structural-steel fabrication, welding and manufacturing.
  • CPEng, RPEQ or progress towards professional registration.
